units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 14:1">Targ. Job XIV, 1</cite> (Ms. <he>גזוז</he>; h. text <he>קצר</he>).—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 27b:7">B. Mets. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>גופו דאריך או ג׳</he> Ms. M. a. H. (ed. <he>דארוך</he>) insufficient signs of the body for identification—e.g. ‘very tall’, ‘dwarfish’.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b:6">Snh. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>כי ג׳ וכ׳</he> when he was short, they stretched him.
<cite ref="Megillah 27b:22">Meg. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>איניש ג׳ הוה</he> was a very short man.
<cite ref="Nedarim 50b:5">Ned. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ ורבה כריסיה</he> short and very stout.—Pl. <he>גּוּצֵי</he>.
Sot. 38ᵇ אריכי באפי ג׳ the tall in front of the small.—Fem. גּוּצָא.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 59a:6">B. Mets. 59ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>אתתך ג׳ וכ׳</he> if thy wife is dwarf, bend down and listen to her (advice), v. <cite ref="L00373"><he>לְחַשׁ</he></cite>.
